# Online Presence Co.

> Websites, local SEO, AI search visibility (GEO), visitor insights, and hosting + care for contractors, trades, home services and local service businesses. Run by Nathan, who works construction himself and quotes every job on a phone call. Phone: (630) 765-0559.

We help contractors, trades, home-service and other local service businesses get found and get called. In person we cover Crystal Lake, McHenry County and the Chicago suburbs. Online we work with businesses anywhere in the US.

How quoting works: a free audit checks the business's website for lead capture, basic SEO, AI-search readiness and automation. Each finding maps to a fix and to one of our 5 programs. Nathan builds a custom plan on a call from the findings that matter to the owner. There are no packages and no fixed prices online. Every business is different. Nathan gives you a straight quote after a short call.

We never promise rankings or placement in AI answers. Your domain is in your name from day one, and the site is yours once the setup is paid. Contact is by phone call or email only; we don't text.

## Programs
- [Websites](https://onlinepresenceco.com/services/websites/): new builds and rebuilds, phone-first, built from real photos and facts, with tap-to-call and a quote form that delivers
- [Local SEO](https://onlinepresenceco.com/services/local-seo/): Google Business Profile setup and upkeep, service and service-area pages, citations and NAP consistency, schema, review requests to every customer, monthly visibility check
- [AI search visibility (GEO)](https://onlinepresenceco.com/services/ai-search-geo/): structured data, entity consistency, answer-style content, llms.txt, AI search crawler access, monthly AI-answer checks
- [Visitor Insights](https://onlinepresenceco.com/services/visitor-insights/): analytics monitoring that finds where visitors leave and why, with a monthly Leak Report
- [Hosting + Care](https://onlinepresenceco.com/services/hosting-care/): hosting, SSL, backups, updates, uptime checks, small edits and a monthly report
